source.title: 【复选框 Checkbox】设计规范v1.2.2608C
source.method: MasterGo get_selection_node; explicit current-file node read

scope: Current admitted desktop calls: scene rules, declared states and actual source relationships; not pixel or whole-family visual approval

findings.sourceFact: 普通组≥2且不互斥，单项仅条款/记住密码/保持登录等开关。
findings.correction: 补齐选型条件；规范样板的普通演示改为两项。

findings.sourceFact: 下拉场景遵守宿主交互；Checkbox分子只管理图标、字体和状态外观。
findings.correction: 保留Select受控标记，禁止再叠加原生input事件。

unverified: Source prose says four interactions while typed set has twelve size/state masters (six per size); typed Disabled/Disabled-checked retained, no new uncheckable-active business rule inferred.
